title: A 45-second animated story about a lonel...
prompt: A 45-second animated story about a lonely robot discovering a garden on Mars.

characters.name: Unit 7
characters.description: Weathered bronze and matte titanium frame with a luminous cyan optic lens.

environments.name: The Crimson Solitude
environments.description: Desolate Martian canyons under deep terracotta skies, revealing a hidden geodesic dome.

scenes.narrative_purpose: Establish the vast, empty isolation of the Red Planet
scenes.visual_description: Vast Martian plains of rust and crimson sand under a twin-moon twilight. Wind sculpts dust waves across towering mesas.
scenes.vo: Four hundred days across the crimson silence. Unit Seven wandered without purpose.

scenes.narrative_purpose: The discovery: anomaly on the optic sensors
scenes.visual_description: Unit 7's single cyan optic sensor pulses. At the base of a shattered obsidian crater, a gentle bioluminescent green glow breaks through the rust.
scenes.character: Unit 7 tilts head, sensor flashing rapidly
scenes.lighting: Cyan sensor spotlight on dark soil
scenes.vo: Until an unexpected sensor signal broke the stillness.

scenes.narrative_purpose: The encounter: an impossibly delicate Martian blossom
scenes.visual_description: Close-up on a fragile, translucent blossom thriving inside an ancient geodesic pocket. Its petals breathe with emerald light.
scenes.lighting: Emerald bioluminescence reflecting off metallic fingers
scenes.vo: Not an echo. Not a glitch. Life, blossoming in the forgotten soil.

scenes.narrative_purpose: Transformation: from desolate machine to devoted guardian
scenes.visual_description: Unit 7 shields the tiny flower from a rising wind with mechanical palms, its optical glow warming to gold.
scenes.character: Unit 7 sheltering the blossom with both hands
scenes.lighting: Warm golden sunrise breaking over Martian peaks
scenes.vo: For the first time on the barren planet... the quiet was no longer lonely.
